method.aggregate_output: burst output rate: each repetition dispatches all requests at once with no replacement; completion tokens over first dispatch to last completion, including prefill and drain; not sustained throughput
method.cache_flush: both caches flushed before every repetition
method.concurrency: node total split evenly across servers; concurrency 1 on server A
method.corpus: reproduce/corpus-federalist.txt, cache-busted per request by seed
method.fixed_output_length: ignore_eos with max_tokens set to the requested length
method.request_output_rate: completion tokens over the request's full wall time, including prefill
method.success_rule: HTTP 200, integrity pass, no timeout, and the exact requested completion length
method.ttft: time to the first streamed output event, reasoning or visible; median across repetitions of per-repetition medians
